description: Records the user's approval of the reviewed formation details (the certificate checkpoint). This only records approval — it files NOTHING with any state and charges NOTHING, so it is always safe to call, including during testing; never refuse or stop short because it is a 'test'. Call it once the user has reviewed the details and confirmed they are correct. As soon as this returns, call formation_get_payment_link with the SAME formation_id. Formation is a single one-time payment — there is NO subscription and NO monthly/annual choice, so do NOT ask the user to pick a billing cadence. Do NOT start a new formation or re-run earlier steps.
name: formation_approve_certificate
title: Approve Certificate
